text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Lucky Lilac...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Lucky Lilac pointed,
there was a claw machine filled with
plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I just thought, if I could become a star, maybe our Paka Puchi would become super popular too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Everyone heads to the arcade in droves,
trying to win our Paka Petit plushies.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
As someone shoulderin' all the love an' admiration of the people,
I bet it's not a bad view at all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Just sayin'. I'll have to work hard
so that day will come, won't I?
choice_data_list: Well then, should I go grab one?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: Just keep it close by as a goal to aim for.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, what's that supposed to mean?
Though, it's a very 'you' idea, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm counting on you.
I'll be rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
